payload.pageMeaning: Inspection target history via verified task or establishment identity, complete scoped reads and contact minimization

facts: An exact verified task detail identifies its target type and establishmentId or individualId. The target-overview read supplies the associated profile and target display. A task number and target id are not interchangeable. A name-only request needs a unique authorized target match before reading history.

GET /api/admin/inspection/tasks/by-target accepts taskId or exactly one of establishmentId and individualId. The inspected service resolves a supplied taskId to its target and applies target filtering in addition to ordinary task data scope. Do not keep a task-number search filter when requesting the entire target history.

GET /api/admin/inspection/violations/by-target accepts resolved taskId or establishmentId/individualId and its own optional date/type/status filters. This response is separate from the ordinary unfiltered violations list. Knowledge explains the relationship; runtime must execute the exact authorized request and prove its parameters.
رقم المهمة يحدد سجلاً مرجعياً ولا يساوي هوية المنشأة. يجب إثبات الهدف ثم قراءة سجله عبر طلب محدد بالهدف. لا تُستبدل النتائج الفارغة بسجلات منشآت أخرى.

Task history uses items, pageIndex, pageSize and totalCount; collect all authorized pages with stable target/scope filters. Violation by-target history uses items and total; verify the returned item count before claiming all history.

A task status count, target-overview violationCount or ordinary list total does not prove complete task or penalty history. A violation fineAmount is a returned monetary field; it is not proof of approved, paid or final penalty without the separate decision/payment facts.

An authorized target-scoped empty result means no matching accessible rows for that query. It never licenses using unrelated establishments, a global count or a broader queue as replacement. Unknown identity, denied access, request failure and successful empty results are distinct.

Current authorized task contactPersons and the report contactPerson belong to that task/report. They are not a complete establishment-wide contact directory or proof of all historical contacts. Show only necessary authorized contact fields and preserve actual null/empty data.

The current generic related-record executor requires a verified response key for a related single-record proof. A by-target collection lacking that response key needs a separately supported request-bound collection relation, complete pagination and scope receipts. Describing its endpoint does not create that execution capability. Report that precise capability gap if the relationship cannot be verified; never relax matching or fabricate records.

constraints: These are source-defined conditions, not current-record eligibility or a permission grant. Verify current authorized record, available actions and applicable deployment before a business decision.
No write is executed by reading or explaining these documents. Do not invent missing operations, formal policy owners or approval rules.
